metadata.name: polybaskets_escrow
metadata.description: AlphaBasket v2 internal-share accounting and backend-authorized settlement program

instructions.name: accept_admin
docs: Accepts administrator authority as the proposed key.

instructions.name: accrue_management_fee
docs: Permissionless crank; dilution is proportional to exact elapsed seconds.

instructions.name: begin_reconstitution
docs: Moves an eligible perpetual basket into reconstitution.

instructions.name: begin_resolution
docs: Stops deposits and starts resolution for a non-perpetual basket.

instructions.name: cancel_admin_transfer
docs: Cancels a pending administrator transfer.

instructions.name: complete_deposit
docs: Completes a user-signed deposit after external Polymarket execution.

instructions.name: complete_protocol_fee_withdrawal
docs: Redeems accrued protocol dilution shares after external execution.

instructions.name: complete_reconstitution
docs: Applies a new Composer-signed canonical composition.

instructions.name: complete_withdrawal
docs: Completes both an active early exit and a final redemption.

instructions.name: create_basket
docs: Only the configured Composer Service key can create a basket.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initializes the singleton configuration under the program upgrade authority.

instructions.name: propose_admin
docs: Starts the two-step administrator transfer.

instructions.name: publish_composition_draft
docs: Publishes a creator-selected weighted composition in a size-safe prior transaction.

instructions.name: publish_eligibility_list
docs: Publishes a short-lived Composer-screened prediction-market list.

instructions.name: record_final_settlement
docs: Records the final NAV and share snapshot for deterministic redemptions.

instructions.name: register_token
docs: Adds, updates, disables, or re-enables a Jupiter spot-token allowlist entry.

instructions.name: set_authorities
docs: Rotates operational signer and treasury authorities.

instructions.name: set_limits
docs: Updates the global user slippage bound.

instructions.name: set_paused
docs: Pauses or resumes user and execution completion flows.

instructions.name: submit_price_attestation
docs: Records a fresh Composer-signed TWAP for a signed-fallback spot token.

types.name: Basket
docs: Basket composition, lifecycle, and aggregate share accounting.

types.name: BasketAsset
docs: One weighted asset in a Composer-signed basket composition.

types.name: BasketStatus
docs: Lifecycle states for a basket.

types.name: CompleteDepositArgs
docs: User intent and backend result used to complete a deposit. The gross amount
and minimum shares are user-authorized; `net_deposit_value` is the actual
value credited by external execution and backs the minted shares.

types.name: CompleteProtocolFeeWithdrawalArgs
docs: Backend result used to redeem protocol-owned dilution shares. The gross
realized value is the actual external execution value.

types.name: CompleteWithdrawalArgs
docs: User intent and backend result used to complete a withdrawal. The share
amount and minimum value are user-authorized; `gross_realized_value` is the
actual external execution value used for fee and proceeds accounting.

types.name: CompositionDraft
docs: Composer-published creator selection. Splitting variable-size items into a
prior transaction keeps create/reconstitution transactions under Solana's
packet limit without weakening Ed25519 authorization.

types.name: Config
docs: Singleton protocol configuration and authority registry.

types.name: CreateBasketArgs
docs: Composer-authorized basket creation parameters.

types.name: EligibilityList
docs: Short-lived Composer-published market list used by basket creation/reconstitution.

types.name: EligibleMarket
docs: One prediction market admitted by the Composer's unchanged six-point screen.
Weights are deliberately absent: creators choose them after eligibility is signed.

types.name: FinalSettlementArgs
docs: Final basket NAV and share-supply snapshot.

types.name: InitializeArgs
docs: Initialization parameters for operational authorities and accounting policy.

types.name: Position
docs: A user's shares, performance-fee basis, and weighted holding timestamp.
`cost_basis_value` is the aggregate HWM/equalization basis of the remaining
shares. Partial redemptions remove only their proportional basis; they do
not raise the per-share basis of unredeemed shares unless those shares also
crystallize a performance fee.

types.name: PositionKind
docs: Tagged representation of a supported basket position.

types.name: PriceAttestation
docs: Latest Composer-signed TWAP fallback for a token without a robust oracle.

fields.name: price_value
docs: Six-decimal settlement-value price, matching the accounting engine.

types.name: ReconstitutionArgs
docs: Composer-authorized replacement composition.

types.name: SettlementAction
docs: Settlement receipt operation type.

types.name: SettlementReceipt
docs: Immutable replay-protected record of a completed accounting settlement.

fields.name: execution_version
docs: Version of the canonical external-execution batch encoding.

fields.name: execution_batch_hash
docs: Hash of all fill markets, outcomes, amounts, prices, and external references.

fields.name: executed_at
docs: Timestamp at which the external execution batch completed.

fields.name: gross_value
docs: Actual value credited for a deposit or realized for a withdrawal.

types.name: TokenAllowlist
docs: Admin-maintained spot-token registry. Disabling an entry blocks new
compositions but never changes or liquidates an existing basket.

types.name: WithdrawalKind
docs: Whether a redemption occurs while active or against a final snapshot.
